title: Brezis-Gallouet-Wainger remainder constant on the torus C16, lower bound
statement: Give mu > 0, and optionally a truncation radius R, for the trial function u = sum c_k e^{ik.x} with c_k = 1/(|k|^2 (1 + mu |k|^2)) over all k != 0 (or 0 < |k| <= R). Its BGW functional 4 pi |u(0)|^2/|grad u|^2 - ln(delta) - ln(1 + ln(delta)), delta = |Lap u|^2/|grad u|^2, is a lower bound for C16; the checker encloses it rigorously and scores the lower end. Larger is better.
submission: JSON: {"mu": p/q or a hex float} for the untruncated family, or {"mu": p/q, "R": integer} for the truncated one.
